name: Option Style 7 Code
definition: Specifies how an option for a derivative or securities derivative can be exercised.

AMER.name: American
AMER.definition: Option can be exercised before or on expiry date.

ASIA.name: Asian
ASIA.definition: Option where the payoff is not determined by the underlying price at maturity but by the average underlying price over some pre-set period of time.

BERM.name: Bermudan
BERM.definition: Option that can be exercised on multiple discrete dates prior to, or on expiry date.

EURO.name: European
EURO.definition: Option that can be exercised on expiry date only.
